reason: A Windows-only desktop tray plugin that provides a tray icon, interface/status/exit menu actions, dynamic web interface access, and informational notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供系统托盘图标、界面与状态菜单、退出操作及气泡通知。
summaries.en: Adds a Windows system tray interface for DeepSeek Harness with menu actions for opening the interface, viewing status, exiting, and showing informational notifications.

capabilities: Creates a Windows system tray icon and menu
Reads the configured webServer port to construct an interface URL
Starts a tray host executable using TCP and XML communication
